name: web_search
description: Search the web and return the best results (title, URL, snippet). Use it for anything current, factual or specific you are not sure about, and whenever you need a URL — never invent or guess URLs. One search is a starting point, not a verdict: if the results do not clear the question up, search again with different or narrower words (synonyms, exact phrases, site: and year qualifiers) — a second or third query beats giving up, and information is not 'not found' just because the first query missed it. Then read the most promising results with fetch_url.
